graduate from college: After I graduate from college, I hope to travel around Europe for a year before looking for a job.
大學畢業後，我希望先去歐洲旅行一年再找工作。
graduate to a bigger role: Once she completes the six-month training program, the intern will graduate to a bigger role on the marketing team.
完成六個月的訓練課程後，這名實習生將晉升到行銷團隊中更大的角色。
graduate with honors: Thanks to years of hard work, my sister was able to graduate with honors from National Taiwan University.
多年的努力讓我姊姊得以以優異成績從台灣大學畢業。
grant permission: The principal agreed to grant permission for the students to hold a concert in the gym on Friday.
校長同意准許學生星期五在體育館舉辦音樂會。
grant a wish: In the story, a magic fish promises to grant a wish to the poor fisherman who sets it free.
故事裡，一條魔法魚答應為放牠自由的窮漁夫實現一個願望。
take for granted: We often take for granted the clean water we drink every day until there is a shortage.
我們常把每天喝的乾淨水視為理所當然，直到缺水才發覺。
grant a loan: The bank refused to grant a loan to the young couple because they didn't have steady jobs.
銀行拒絕核貸給這對年輕夫婦，因為他們沒有穩定的工作。
granted that: Even granted that the weather was bad, the team should not have canceled the game without telling anyone.
就算天氣不好，球隊也不該沒通知任何人就取消比賽。
grant asylum: The government decided to grant asylum to the reporter who had escaped from her dangerous home country.
政府決定給予那位從危險祖國逃出的記者庇護。
grasp the concept: It took me several examples to fully grasp the concept of gravity in my physics class.
我看了好幾個例子才在物理課上完全理解重力的概念。
grasp the opportunity: If you get the chance to study abroad, you should grasp the opportunity because it may not come again.
如果你有機會出國讀書，就應該抓住機會，因為它可能不會再來。
grasp the meaning: Even after reading the poem three times, I still couldn't grasp the meaning of its last line.
即使讀了這首詩三遍，我還是無法掌握最後一行的意思。
within one's grasp: After years of training, the gold medal was finally within her grasp, and she was not going to let it go.
經過多年訓練，金牌終於唾手可得，她絕不會讓它溜走。
grasp at straws: When the judge asked for real evidence, the lawyer had nothing solid and could only grasp at straws.
法官要求真正的證據時，律師拿不出任何有力的東西，只能抓救命稻草。
grieve for the dead: Every year on this day, the whole village gathers to grieve for the dead who lost their lives in the earthquake.
每年的這一天，全村的人都會聚在一起哀悼在地震中喪生的死者。
grieve over a loss: It's normal to grieve over a loss for months, so give yourself time to feel sad and heal.
為失去而悲痛好幾個月是很正常的，所以給自己一些時間難過和療傷。
it grieves me to say: I know you worked hard, and it grieves me to say that your team did not win the contest.
我知道你們很努力，我很痛心地說你們的隊伍沒有贏得比賽。
grill a suspect: The police continued to grill a suspect for six hours, but he refused to tell them anything.
警方持續盤問嫌犯六個小時，但他什麼都不肯說。
be grilled by reporters: After the scandal, the mayor was grilled by reporters for two hours about where the missing money had gone.
醜聞爆發後，市長被記者逼問了兩個小時，追問失蹤的錢流向何處。
grill meat: On Moon Festival night, many Taiwanese families gather outside to grill meat and enjoy the full moon together.
中秋節晚上，許多台灣家庭聚在戶外烤肉，一起賞月。
grind to a halt: Traffic in the city began to grind to a halt after the heavy rain flooded several main roads.
大雨淹沒了幾條主要道路後，市區交通開始停擺。
grind one's teeth: My brother tends to grind his teeth in his sleep when he's worried about exams, which wakes me up.
我弟弟擔心考試時常在睡夢中磨牙，把我吵醒。
the daily grind: After weeks of the daily grind at the office, I really need a relaxing vacation by the sea.
在辦公室忙了好幾週的日常苦差後，我真的需要去海邊好好放鬆度假。
grind coffee: Every morning my dad gets up early to grind coffee by hand before making breakfast for the family.
每天早上我爸爸都早起手工磨咖啡，然後為家人做早餐。
grind someone down: Years of hard work and low pay can slowly grind people down until they lose all hope.
多年辛苦工作又低薪，會慢慢折磨人，直到他們失去所有希望。
grip the audience: The film's exciting opening scene will grip the audience from the very first minute.
這部電影刺激的開場從第一分鐘起就扣人心弦。
grip the wheel: When the car started to slide on the icy road, I had to grip the wheel tightly with both hands.
車子在結冰的路上開始打滑時，我必須用雙手緊握方向盤。
fear gripped the city: When news of the killer spread, fear gripped the city, and people stayed home at night.
殺人犯的消息傳開後，恐懼籠罩城市，人們晚上都待在家裡。
get a grip: You're panicking over one small mistake, so take a deep breath, get a grip, and try the question again.
你只是因為一個小錯誤就慌了，深呼吸、振作起來，再試一次這題。
lose one's grip: I've been working so hard lately that I feel I'm starting to lose my grip and forget simple things.
我最近工作太拚，覺得自己開始失控，連簡單的事都會忘記。
in the grip of: The whole country was in the grip of a terrible heat wave last summer, and many people got sick.
去年夏天全國受到可怕熱浪的控制，許多人因此生病。
